title: NONOS marketplace index
description: The marketplace index as JSON, field for field with userland/marketplace_abi, the codec capsule_market decodes and nonos-mk encodes. The wire form is a length-prefixed little-endian blob signed whole by the operator's Ed25519 key; nothing may follow the signature. Schema 3 is the only one written; schema 2 still decodes, and its entries carry no commerce block, so nothing in one can be bought. Hex is lowercase without 0x, except Ethereum addresses, which carry 0x. Empty hex means all zero. Per-package detail lives inside the package (capsule_manifest.schema.json, capsule_package.schema.json).

schema_version.description: 3 is the only schema the encoder writes. 2: every release carries its zk trailer hash. 3: every entry carries a commerce block and every release the fields that sell it.

operator_pubkey.description: Ed25519 key, 32 bytes. The capsule trusts an index only after index_signature checks against it and the key is one it trusts.

serial.description: Strictly increasing. capsule_market refuses a serial at or below the last one it accepted.

index_signature.description: Ed25519 over every byte of the encoded index before the signature's length prefix.

listing_id.description: The market id, such as linux.qwenchat: the appId the on-chain listingId is derived from (plan/23).

publisher_pubkey.description: The publisher's Ed25519 key. Every release must verify under it, and it is the publisherKey of listingId and bondId.

publisher_eth_address.description: Carried from schema 2. Who is paid is commerce.payee, never this.

commerce.description: Required in schema 3, absent in schema 2.

kind.description: On the wire one byte, 0 to 3. Any other byte is refused, never read as free.

amount_atomic.description: u128 in the token's smallest unit.

chain_id.description: The chain the commerce binding is checked on; 1 in production, 11155111 for tests.

contract_address.description: Empty for the chain's native token.

Commerce.description: What the listing sells and who is paid (plan/23). The operator signs it with the index, and every release signs its BLAKE3 hash (commerce_hash), so neither can change price or payee behind the other.

payee.description: The account paid. A zero payee sells nothing.

bond_id.description: keccak256(abi.encode(BOND_TAG, payee, publisherKey)). Empty is derived; any other value must equal it.

unit.description: On the wire keccak256 of the label, as nonos_nox_config names them.

settle_mode.description: On the wire 0, 1, 2; any other byte is refused. Escrow requires every release to carry chunk_root and content_len.

kind.description: plan/11 container kind: isolation, delivery, authenticity.

statement.description: The program hash a container must verify under.

binding_sig.description: PublisherBinding(publisherKey, listingId, bondId), EIP-712 under the NONOS Bond domain on token.chain_id, signed by payee: r, s, v.

release_id.description: The version string the on-chain releaseId is derived from.

publisher_signature.description: Ed25519 over the release signing bytes: domain NONOS.marketplace.release.v3 when the release has ext, v2 when it has none.

items.description: x86_64-nonos, aarch64-nonos, riscv64-nonos, or a hosted triple such as x86_64-linux.

zk_trailer_hash.description: BLAKE3 of the release's zk trailer; empty when it ships none.

ext.description: Required in schema 3, absent in schema 2.

commerce_hash.description: BLAKE3("NONOS.marketplace.commerce.v1" | commerce block bytes). nonos-mk sign-release sets it before signing.

guest_policy.description: A LinuxAppPolicy (plan/30), exactly 256 bytes, or empty.

chunk_root.description: Root of the 1024-byte chunk tree (plan/21); required for escrow.

content_len.description: Package length in bytes; required for escrow.

release_attest_sig.description: The payee's EIP-712 ReleaseAttest (plan/23) over listingId, releaseId, bondId, chunkRoot, contentLen and packageHash, r | s | v; empty when the entry has no payee.
